credit: NASA/Goddard Space Flight Center, Reto Stoeckli; Blue Marble Clouds
description: Historical satellite cloud composite. Source description combines two days visible imagery and a third day thermal infrared imagery over the poles. Not live weather.
processing: Grayscale Lanczos global512x256 JPEG45, regional1024x512 JPEG65, bounds west=-45 east=45 south=20 north=56. Original cloud structures preserved.
simulation: Raised 9km shell, soft directional shadows, initial longitude offset and slow uniform eastward drift; no meteorological forecast.
